_comment: Single source of truth for the negotiation tiers and product coverage panels. Edit this file, then run scripts/push-pricing-config.ps1 to push the tool schema to the live persona. See docs/OPERATIONS.md for the full how-to. Do NOT edit the numbers in prompts/digital-finance-manager/system-instruction.md separately without also updating them here — they must match.

vsc.label: 10-Year Bumper-to-Bumper
vsc.title: 10-Year, 100,000-Mile Bumper-to-Bumper
vsc.description: Wraps a blanket-cover contract around the vehicle for wear-and-tear failures the factory warranty won't pay for — the same major components, but covered no matter what caused the breakdown.
bullets: Drive axle and four-wheel drive components

maintenance.label: Maintenance Plan
maintenance.title: 5-Year Maintenance Cover
maintenance.description: Routine scheduled maintenance for the next five years, taken care of — no more paying out of pocket every time it's due.
bullets: Covers the next 5 years of scheduled service

tire_wheel.label: Tire & Wheel Coverage
tire_wheel.title: 5-Year Tire & Wheel Coverage
tire_wheel.description: Potholes, blowouts, and road hazards happen — this covers the tires and wheels for the next five years.
bullets: Blowouts and road-hazard tire damage replaced at no cost
Cosmetic rim damage from potholes repaired

gap.label: GAP Coverage
gap.title: GAP Coverage
gap.description: If the vehicle is totaled, stolen, or destroyed and the insurance payout doesn't cover the full loan balance, GAP covers the difference — so you're not paying out of pocket on a vehicle you no longer have.
bullets: Covers the gap between insurance payout and loan balance
Applies to accident, theft, hail, flood, and fire total losses
No out-of-pocket balance left on a vehicle you no longer have
